_source: DiscountEntity, the 200 response of POST /v1/discounts at https://docs.creem.io/api-reference/endpoint/create-discount-code (field names, types and enums from that schema; required: id, mode, object, status, name, code, type). Values are the 30% code GoPayLocal would create; id prefix from the OrderEntity.discount example (dis_1234567890) in https://docs.creem.io/api-reference/openapi.json.
name: PPP NL 30%
